name: Sentinel-2 L2A MGRS-36RUV window (2023-08-06)
what_it_is: Real Copernicus Sentinel-2 MSI Level-2A surface-reflectance window: 2048x2048 px at 10 m (20.5 km), 4 bands (B02 blue, B03 green, B04 red, B08 nir), uint16 DN, EPSG:32636, nodata=0. Extracted from the AWS Open Data COG archive.
not_good_for: change detection (only one date is bundled)
notes: Reflectance = DN/10000. The STAC raster:bands metadata advertises offset -0.1, but applying it makes ~98% of pixels negative, so BOA_ADD_OFFSET is 0 for this baseline (verified empirically -- see docs/PHASE2.md). Bands 1-4 are NOT in wavelength order: order is blue, green, red, nir.
